caption:
Since working from home, Momo has been barefoot on hard tiles all day, and lately her arches feel sore.

Going barefoot isn't bad in itself. Often it's the sudden jump in time spent standing on hard floors that leaves feet tired. Building foot strength and easing into the change can help.

Hybi's 1-minute reset: towel scrunch, 10 reps, plus a calf stretch against the wall, 30 seconds, twice. Once or twice a day.

Very painful first steps in the morning, swelling, or no change after two to three weeks are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
